title: Sushil T. Williams vs Smt. Kakoli Williams on 16 October, 2024

paragraphs.text:
HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
 
 


?Court No. - 39
 

 
Case :- FIRST APPEAL No. - 65 of 2017
 

 
Appellant :- Sushil T. Williams
 
Respondent :- Smt. Kakoli Williams
 
Counsel for Appellant :- Rajeshwar Prasad Sinha
 

 
Hon'ble Saumitra Dayal Singh,J.
1. List revised. None is present for the appellant, in either call.

2. The present appeal has been filed under Section 19 of the Family Courts Act, 1984 arising from the judgment and order dated 02.01.2017 passed by Principal Judge, Family Court, Allahabad in Matrimonial Petition No.686 of 2015 ( Sushil T Williams Vs. Smt. Kakoli Williams ) whereby proceedings for divorce under Section 10 A of the Divorce Act, 1869 have been dismissed.
3. Perusal of the impugned order reveals, proceedings have been wrongly described as proceedings under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.
4. The present appeal is dismissed for want of prosecution.

Order Date :- 16.10.2024
